description: This file implements the 'discover' command for a macOS CLI application related to OpenClaw, handling discovery options, output formatting, and the main discovery process including JSON serialization and display logic.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Holds command-line options for discovery, provides parsing logic.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Defines the structure of the JSON output for discovery results, including nested Gateway struct.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments and returns a DiscoveryOptions instance with configured options.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Main asynchronous function executing the discovery process based on provided arguments, handles displaying results or JSON output.
